    Frequently Asked Questions

    Everything you need to know about our website development services.

    What is included in Website Development Services?
    +

    Our services include custom design, frontend and backend development, CMS integration, eCommerce setup, responsive design, SEO foundations, testing, launch, and support.

    How long does a website development project take?
    +

    Project timelines vary depending on complexity. Simple business sites typically take 4–8 weeks, while eCommerce and enterprise platforms may take longer.

    Will my site be mobile-friendly?
    +

    Yes. Every website we build is fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices.

    Do you offer website maintenance?
    +

    Absolutely. We offer ongoing support plans tailored to your needs.

    Can you update my existing website?
    +

    Yes, we offer redesign, upgrades, and migrations to modern platforms.
